body: Redis cache entries expire after fifteen minutes. Invalidation is triggered immediately after a successful write transaction.
title: Redis cache expiration

body: The cache uses an allkeys-lru eviction policy when memory reaches the configured limit. Cache hit rate is measured every minute.
title: Cache memory pressure

body: Severity one incidents require acknowledgement within five minutes. The incident commander posts updates every fifteen minutes.
title: Critical incident response

body: Severity two incidents require acknowledgement within thirty minutes. The primary on-call engineer coordinates the response.
title: High severity incidents

body: Database snapshots are taken every six hours. Daily backups are retained for thirty days and monthly backups for one year.
title: Database backup retention

body: Restore rehearsals run every quarter in an isolated staging environment. The recovery point objective is six hours.
title: Database restore procedure

body: Deployments begin with five percent of traffic. The rollout pauses automatically when the five-minute error rate exceeds two percent.
title: Progressive deployment

body: Rollback starts when latency exceeds the agreed service objective for ten consecutive minutes. The last stable release is restored.
title: Deployment rollback

body: Service accounts are reviewed every ninety days. Access grants must have an owner and an expiration date.
title: Service access reviews

body: Production API keys rotate every sixty days. Revoked keys cannot authenticate after the next cache refresh.
title: API key rotation

body: Alerts for payment services are sent to the payments on-call rotation. Non-urgent alerts are grouped into hourly summaries.
title: Alert routing

body: The checkout service targets 99.9 percent availability over thirty days. Error budget burn is calculated using five-minute and one-hour windows.
title: Service level objectives
